app_type: hybrid_fullstack (Hindi News Portal + AI Content Admin Dashboard)

design_philosophy.identity: The premier digital Hindi news publication for Ghaziabad, Delhi-NCR, Uttar Pradesh, and India. Modern editorial aesthetics meets high-velocity journalism with crystal-clear Devanagari typography.
design_philosophy.theme_mode: Light mode default (#F9F9F9) with smooth toggle to Dark mode (#121212)

brand_primary.name: Breaking News Crimson
brand_primary.usage: Top masthead bar, live breaking news tickers, urgent tags, main action CTA buttons, active state indicators

brand_secondary.name: Charcoal Slate
brand_secondary.usage: Primary headlines, long-form Hindi body text in light mode, high contrast structural borders

accent_gold.name: Warm Amber Gold
accent_gold.usage: Category pill badges (e.g., राजनीति, अपराध, खेल, धर्म), featured story borders, special coverage highlights, star ratings

line_height_rules.hindi_body: 1.7 to 1.8 (CRITICAL: Devanagari vowel matras above and below baseline require extra vertical breathing room to prevent line clashing)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold leading-tight tracking-normal
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold border-l-4 border-[#B71C1C] pl-3 leading-snug
hierarchy.h3_card: text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold hover:text-[#B71C1C] transition-colors leading-relaxed

header_and_navigation.top_utility_bar: Deep Crimson (#B71C1C) background with white text displaying live Hindi Date, Weather (गाज़ियाबाद 32°C), e-Paper link, and Dark/Light Mode switch.
header_and_navigation.brand_header: White/Dark surface showcasing bold bilingual logo ('गाज़ियाबाद टाइम्स / GHAZIABAD TIMES'), edition dropdown (गाज़ियाबाद, नोएडा, ग्रेटर नोएडा, दिल्ली, लखनऊ), search trigger, and 'विज्ञापन दें' (Advertise) CTA.
header_and_navigation.main_nav_sticky: Sticky responsive navigation bar with glassmorphism backdrop (`backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#121212]/90 z-40`), featuring primary categories: मुख्य समाचार (Home), ब्रेकिंग (Breaking), देश (National), राजनीति (Politics), राज्य एवं जिला (States/Districts with sub-menu for Delhi NCR, UP, Haryana, Punjab, Rajasthan, UK), खेल (Sports), जीवनशैली (Lifestyle), and AI Dashboard (Admin).

ticker_bar.style: Flex box with a static high-urgency 'ताज़ा ख़बर / BREAKING' tag in Crimson Red + flashing dot indicator, followed by a smooth marquee auto-scrolling live news headlines with pause-on-hover capability.

grid_modes.hero_featured_grid: Asymmetric Bento Layout: 1 primary large hero card (spans 8 cols on desktop) with prominent image + headline + excerpt + gold tag, flanked by 4 vertical trending story cards (spans 4 cols).
grid_modes.district_news_tabs: Interactive State & District filter tab strip (गाज़ियाबाद, नोएडा, हापुड़, ग्रेटर नोएडा, दिल्ली NCR, लखनऊ) with high-density grid cards.
grid_modes.admin_dashboard_split: Dual-pane desktop view: Left side 40% (Pending News Aggregator Feed with source metadata and confidence score), Right side 60% (Interactive AI Rewriter workspace with side-by-side original vs rewritten comparison, image watermark generator toggle, and Publish/Reject actions).

watermarking_and_media.watermark_overlay: Every uploaded or approved article image MUST feature a dynamic subtle translucent brand watermark badge in the bottom-right corner reading 'गाज़ियाबाद टाइम्स © GHAZIABAD TIMES' with custom SVG logo overlay.

news_card.container: group bg-card hover:bg-muted/40 transition-all duration-200 border border-border rounded-lg overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
news_card.badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-[#D4AC0D]/15 text-[#B71C1C] dark:text-[#D4AC0D] border border-[#D4AC0D]/30

admin_approval_queue.item: p-4 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card space-y-3

ad_banner_slot.style: bg-muted/50 border border-dashed border-muted-foreground/30 p-4 rounded-lg text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-xs text-muted-foreground

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive buttons, links, search inputs, mode toggles, category tabs, admin action buttons, and article titles MUST contain descriptive data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts ('Hind', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', 'Rozha One', 'Outfit') into public/index.html or index.css.
Ensure Devanagari typography has clear font size scaling and line-height of 1.7 to prevent Hindi character overlap.
Use exact color hex values specified: Crimson #B71C1C for header/breaking tags, Gold #D4AC0D for badges, Charcoal #1A1A1A for text.
Implement automated news aggregation mock queue in Admin Dashboard with approval, AI-rewrite preview side-by-side, and image watermarking preview.
Include state & district filter views: UP (Ghaziabad, Noida, Greater Noida, Hapur, Lucknow), Delhi NCR, Haryana, Punjab, Rajasthan, UK.
Ensure full responsive behavior across laptops, tablets, and smartphones (mobile drawer menu, touch-friendly ticker, responsive grids).
Include complete legal disclaimer page, jurisdiction clause in footer, advertise page with mock UPI/Card payment modal, and active social media links.
Attach data-testid attributes to all key interactive elements.
